metadata.description: YOUR AIOS 2.0: start small; install the next pack when you need it.

plugins.name: skool-navaigate-install
plugins.description: First-generation community skills: fixes-only support until 26 April 2027.

plugins.name: aios
plugins.description: Start here. Check your harnesses and choose your next module.

plugins.name: aios-rules
plugins.description: Module 2: your folder map, one short AGENTS.md, path-scoped rules, a budget check and a monthly audit.

plugins.name: aios-harnesses
plugins.description: Module 3: set up Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok Bot on one folder, and check they match.

plugins.name: aios-bb
plugins.description: Module 4: bb as the cockpit - project setup, the board and the daily loop.

plugins.name: aios-brain
plugins.description: Your own local memory, with optional sync to your own Turso database.

plugins.name: aios-skills
plugins.description: Module 6. Write, measure, hide and test skills, and scaffold new ones with their evals.

plugins.name: aios-agents
plugins.description: Module 7. When a sub-agent earns its place, a brief template and checker, and a small read-only crew.

plugins.name: aios-verify
plugins.description: Module 8. Checks, a Stop gate, REVIEW.md and a PR template, and hooks for no secrets, no destructive git and confirm before production.

plugins.name: aios-methods
plugins.description: Module 9. Loops with a check, worktrees for parallel work, interview before you build.

plugins.name: aios-models
plugins.description: Module 10. Which model does what, medium effort first, the advisor, and two logins.

plugins.name: aios-ship
plugins.description: Module 11. Package a skill as a pack with tests, evals and installers, then validate it.

plugins.name: shelf-decks
plugins.description: The shelf: a deck in your own brand. HTML first, every slide reviewed, then an editable PowerPoint and a PDF.

plugins.name: shelf-invoices
plugins.description: The shelf: invoices and credit notes as PDF from your own company details, numbered, filed and verified.

plugins.name: shelf-video
plugins.description: The shelf: edit a talking-head recording locally. Whisper transcript, filler words out, captions in, MP4 out.

plugins.name: tools-boards
plugins.description: Tools: editable BluPlai whiteboards from a brief or a transcript, native shapes, validated before they are written.

plugins.name: tools-images
plugins.description: Tools: images and AI video on your own Higgsfield, shot-by-shot prompts checked before credits are spent.

plugins.name: tools-inbox
plugins.description: Tools: inbox triage on your own Composio and Gmail. Sorted into what needs you, drafts only, never sends.

plugins.name: tools-meetings
plugins.description: Tools: Granola meetings on your own key, turned into checked decisions, owners and open questions.

plugins.name: tools-memory
plugins.description: Tools: one app database in step across your machines on your own Turso, checked first, and clipboard recall with Paste.

plugins.name: tools-narration
plugins.description: Tools: narration in your own cloned voice on your own ElevenLabs account, one consistent take per deck.

plugins.name: tools-notebooklm
plugins.description: Tools: your files into NotebookLM notebooks, audio overviews and quizzes on your own Google account.

plugins.name: tools-offers
plugins.description: Tools: the Hormozi Growth Engine on the books you own, with cited answers, and the James Smith second view.

plugins.name: tools-research
plugins.description: Tools: papers, Substack, Reddit on your own app and YouTube consensus, in a ledger with links and honest confidence.

plugins.name: tools-reverse
plugins.description: Tools: how shipped software works, explained with REA inside a scope you may work in, every claim with evidence.

plugins.name: tools-social
plugins.description: Tools: one source to every platform on your own Blotato, with a release gate. Nothing posts without your go.

plugins.name: tools-tasks
plugins.description: Tools: briefs into checked tasks in your own ClickUp, through ClickUp's official MCP server, and three for today.

plugins.name: tools-voice
plugins.description: Tools: your own writing voice, built from your own words and corrections, and a check for every draft.

plugins.name: tools-whatsapp
plugins.description: Tools: WhatsApp archived on your own Mac with whatscribe, voice notes as text, and every date and price found.

plugins.name: aios-complete
plugins.description: The whole framework in one install: aios, the brain and every core pack for modules 2 to 11.
